description:
IPTV player for your own M3U and Xtream Codes playlists, with program guide and recording.

Nightmare TV is an IPTV player for playlists you already have. Add an M3U or M3U8 link or file, or sign in with your provider's Xtream Codes details. No channels, playlists or subscriptions are included.
Playback runs on the libmpv engine with HDR tone mapping. The program guide reads XMLTV (EPG) data, and catch-up works where your provider supports it. On Windows you can record live or schedule recordings, and multiview lets you watch several channels side by side.
Every install starts with a 14-day free trial, no card and no account required. A paid license is needed to keep using the app after the trial.
